response.sql:
WITH large_orders AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, o.amount, d.A3
    FROM `order` o
    JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE o.amount >= 2802
),
group_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        A3,
        AVG(amount) AS group_avg
    FROM large_orders
    GROUP BY account_id, A3
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_average
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT 
    ga.account_id,
    ga.A3,
    ga.group_avg,
    ga.group_avg - oa.overall_average AS difference
FROM group_averages ga
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff of 2802 is interpreted as amount >= 2802 (greater than or equal to), following standard data analysis convention where a threshold of X includes X and above

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff of 2802 could be interpreted as strictly greater than (amount > 2802), excluding orders with amount exactly equal to 2802
